faq.title: Common questions about the platform
faq.description: V1 focuses on the content platform loop, not paid subscriptions or a full community.

items.title: How is this related to the old personal site?
items.description: The new site preserves the old about page, posts, images, and AI entry while upgrading the core positioning into a one-stop AI Web SaaS resource platform.

items.title: How should I use this resource platform?
items.description: Filter the library by product-building stage, use collections to assemble practical workflows, and use articles and the profile page for first-hand context.

items.title: Will V1 include payments or credits?
items.description: No. The SPEC says V1 hides Pricing, payments, subscriptions, Credits, and points, keeping only the capabilities needed by the resource platform.

items.title: How will the AI assistant answer?
items.description: It answers from site resources, collections, articles, and profile content that allow citation, with source links. If no source is found, it says so.
